description: This file contains utility functions for parsing CSS-like color strings, filenames, booleans, and numeric lists, primarily used within the Kivy framework for UI rendering.

classes.name: ColorException
classes.description: Custom exception class for color parsing errors.

methods.name: parse_filename
methods.description: Resolves a filename to a resource path if found, otherwise returns the original filename.

methods.name: color_error
methods.description: Logs a warning and returns a default black color with full opacity.

methods.name: parse_color
methods.description: Parses a string into a RGBA color list supporting various formats including rgb(), rgba(), hex codes.

methods.name: parse_bool
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value, accepting 'true', '1', 'false', '0'.

methods.name: parse_string
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string and trims whitespace.

methods.name: parse_int2
methods.description: Parses a string into a list of two integers, duplicating if only one value is provided.

methods.name: parse_float4
methods.description: Parses a string into a list of four floats, with various input length handling.
